cases.name: stale summary with 503 keeps common actions and previous data
cases.expected: 503 plus old summary keeps marked metrics/activity/time and actionable OutlinedButton common action, hides primary.

cases.name: network retry keeps stale summary until a fresh result arrives
cases.expected: Retry callback once; while refreshing header disabled and FailureView retry/reauth absent, old count/time retained; fresh result clears error/stale notice and replaces count/time/primary.

cases.name: background refresh preserves prior activity and common actions
cases.expected: Refresh without error retains marked activity/time/common action, disables header and hides data-dependent primary.

cases.name: 412 preserves the submitted draft and blocks held save callbacks
cases.expected: Synchronous duplicate submit lock; 412 selects submitted draft, no save controls/replay, close and held save do not resubmit; route Future returns null.

cases.name: unknown result retries the same payload before a 412 stops replay
cases.expected: ApiFailure0 keeps original payload object; retry same object, then412 replaces unknown state with draft and rejects held retry; closes null.

cases.name: access loss hides a 412 draft and gives original workspace guidance
cases.expected: Revocation synchronously blocks old callbacks before pump; draft hidden, precise current/original workspace guidance shown, safe close null.

cases.name: access loss during submission hides a late 412 and prevents resubmit
cases.expected: Pending submit then revocation then late412 never exposes draft or replays, safe close null.

cases.name: 412 draft preserves trimmed text numeric labels and empty fields
cases.expected: Initial valid submit creates exact trimmed text/int/raw dropdown code/empty Map, then412 displays text/int/dropdown label/(空) in exact multiline SelectableText; held save no replay and close null.
